mapper.insert: INSERT INTO HSBA010T_TBL (CMPYCD, ITEMCD, ITEMNM, ITEMENM, ITSIZE, UNIT, UNITNM, INUNIT, INUNITNM, ICQTY, OUTUNIT, OUTUNITNM, OCQTY, SETYN, ASTKIND, AGRPCD, BGRPCD, IMPRICE, OMPRICE, STOCK, QTYPNT, VATYN, SOTAXYN, UDOGYN, BARCODE, HSCODE, REMARK, USEYN, IN_CUSTCD, AUTOYN, ADDTIME, UPDTIME, UPDEMP) VALUES (#{cmpycd}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{itemcd}, ''), CONCAT( CASE #{astkind} WHEN '100' THEN 'R' WHEN '110' THEN 'A' WHEN '111' THEN 'B' WHEN '120' THEN 'G' WHEN '200' THEN 'P' WHEN '210' THEN 'W' WHEN '900' THEN 'S' WHEN '910' THEN 'S' ELSE 'G' END, LPAD(IFNULL((SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(x.ITEMCD, 2, 6) AS UNSIGNED)) FROM HSBA010T_TBL x WHERE x.CMPYCD = #{cmpycd} AND SUBSTRING(x.ITEMCD, 1, 1) = CASE #{astkind} WHEN '100' THEN 'R' WHEN '110' THEN 'A' WHEN '111' THEN 'B' WHEN '120' THEN 'G' WHEN '200' THEN 'P' WHEN '210' THEN 'W' WHEN '900' THEN 'S' WHEN '910' THEN 'S' ELSE 'G' END), 0) + 1, 6, '0') )), #{itemnm}, #{itemenm}, #{itsize}, #{unit}, (SELECT UNITNM FROM HSBA040T_TBL WHERE CMPYCD = #{cmpycd} AND UNIT = #{unit}), #{inunit}, (SELECT UNITNM FROM HSBA040T_TBL WHERE CMPYCD = #{cmpycd} AND UNIT = #{inunit}), IFNULL(#{icqty}, 0), #{outunit}, (SELECT UNITNM FROM HSBA040T_TBL WHERE CMPYCD = #{cmpycd} AND UNIT = #{outunit}), IFNULL(#{ocqty}, 0), #{setyn}, #{astkind}, #{agrpcd}, #{bgrpcd}, IFNULL(#{imprice}, 0), IFNULL(#{omprice}, 0), IFNULL(#{stock}, 0), IFNULL(#{qtypnt}, 0), IFNULL(#{vatyn}, 'N'), IFNULL(#{sotaxyn}, 'N'), IFNULL(#{udogyn}, 'N'), #{barcode}, #{hscode}, #{remark}, #{useyn}, #{in_custcd}, IFNULL(#{autoyn}, 'N'), NOW(), NOW(), #{updemp})
mapper.update: UPDATE HSBA010T_TBL SET ITEMNM = #{itemnm}, ITEMENM = #{itemenm}, ITSIZE = #{itsize}, UNIT = #{unit}, UNITNM = (SELECT UNITNM FROM HSBA040T_TBL WHERE CMPYCD = #{cmpycd} AND UNIT = #{unit}), INUNIT = #{inunit}, INUNITNM = (SELECT UNITNM FROM HSBA040T_TBL WHERE CMPYCD = #{cmpycd} AND UNIT = #{inunit}), ICQTY = #{icqty}, OUTUNIT = #{outunit}, OUTUNITNM = (SELECT UNITNM FROM HSBA040T_TBL WHERE CMPYCD = #{cmpycd} AND UNIT = #{outunit}), OCQTY = #{ocqty}, SETYN = #{setyn}, ASTKIND = #{astkind}, AGRPCD = #{agrpcd}, BGRPCD = #{bgrpcd}, IMPRICE = #{imprice}, OMPRICE = #{omprice}, STOCK = #{stock}, QTYPNT = #{qtypnt}, VATYN = #{vatyn}, SOTAXYN = #{sotaxyn}, UDOGYN = #{udogyn}, BARCODE = #{barcode}, HSCODE = #{hscode}, REMARK = #{remark}, USEYN = #{useyn}, IN_CUSTCD = #{in_custcd}, AUTOYN = #{autoyn}, UPDTIME = NOW(), UPDEMP = #{updemp} WHERE CMPYCD = #{cmpycd} AND ITEMCD = #{itemcd}

choose.when: SELECT A.CUSTCD, A.CUSTNO, A.CUSTNM, A.CUSTGBN, A.BOSSNM, A.JUMINNO, A.LEGALNO, A.CUSTKIND, A.CUSTTYPE, A.TELNO, A.FAXNO, A.POSTNO, A.ADDRESS, A.D_ADDRESS, A.IOGBN, J.CODENM AS IOGBNNM, IFNULL(B.INPRCGBN,'000') AS INPRCGBN, IFNULL(B.OUTPRCGBN,'000') AS OUTPRCGBN, IFNULL(B.HDAMT,0) AS HDAMT, IFNULL(B.RCVDD,0) AS RCVDD, IFNULL(B.AGRPCD,'000') AS AGRPCD, IFNULL(B.BGRPCD,'000') AS BGRPCD, IFNULL(B.CGRPCD,'000') AS CGRPCD, IFNULL(B.AREA,'000') AS AREA, B.DAMDANG AS CDAMDANG, B.TELNO AS CTELNO, B.EMAIL AS CEMAIL, B.REMARK, C.CDNM AS INPRCGBNM, D.CDNM AS OUTPRCGBNM, E.CDNM AS AGRPNM, F.CDNM AS BGRPNM, G.CDNM AS AREANM , A.STATUS, I.CODENM AS STATUSNM, A.USEYN, A.BANKNM, A.GUJOA, A.FNDYMD, A.STDYMD, A.CLSYMD, A.SINGRD, K.CODENM AS CUSTGBNM, A.ELCYN, A.GIGBCD, A.OUTCUSTCD FROM HABA020T_TBL A LEFT OUTER JOIN HSBA100T_TBL B ON A.CMPYCD = B.CMPYCD AND A.CUSTCD = B.CUSTCD LEFT OUTER JOIN HSBA900T_TBL C ON B.CMPYCD = C.CMPYCD AND B.INPRCGBN = C.CODE AND C.CDGBN = '200' LEFT OUTER JOIN HSBA900T_TBL D ON B.CMPYCD = D.CMPYCD AND B.OUTPRCGBN = D.CODE AND D.CDGBN = '200' LEFT OUTER JOIN HSBA900T_TBL E ON B.CMPYCD = E.CMPYCD AND B.AGRPCD = E.CODE AND E.CDGBN = '400' LEFT OUTER JOIN HSBA900T_TBL F ON B.CMPYCD = F.CMPYCD AND B.BGRPCD = F.CODE AND F.CDGBN = '410' LEFT OUTER JOIN HSBA900T_TBL G ON B.CMPYCD = G.CMPYCD AND B.AREA = G.CODE AND G.CDGBN = '430' LEFT OUTER JOIN HABA900T_TBL I ON A.STATUS = I.CODECD AND I.CDTYPE = '280' LEFT OUTER JOIN HABA900T_TBL J ON A.IOGBN = J.CODECD AND J.CDTYPE = '340' LEFT OUTER JOIN HABA900T_TBL K ON A.CUSTGBN = K.CODECD AND K.CDTYPE = '270' WHERE A.CMPYCD = #{cmpycd} AND A.CUSTCD >= #{custcd} AND A.STATUS in ('010','020','030') ORDER BY A.CUSTCD

mapper.update: UPDATE HABA020T_TBL SET CUSTNO = #{custno}, CUSTNM = #{custnm}, CUSTGBN = #{custgbn}, BOSSNM = #{bossnm}, LEGALNO = #{legalno}, CUSTKIND = #{custkind}, CUSTTYPE = #{custtype}, TELNO = #{telno}, FAXNO = #{faxno}, POSTNO = #{postno}, ADDRESS = #{address}, D_ADDRESS = #{d_address}, STATUS = #{status}, IOGBN = #{iogbn}, FNDYMD = #{fndymd}, STDYMD = #{stdymd}, CLSYMD = #{clsymd}, SINGRD = #{singrd}, ELCYN = #{elcyn}, USEYN = #{useyn}, BANKNM = #{banknm}, GUJOA = #{gujoa}, UPDTIME = NOW(), UPDEMP = #{updemp}, GIGBCD = #{gigbcd}, OUTCUSTCD = #{outcustcd} WHERE CMPYCD = #{cmpycd} AND CUSTCD = #{custcd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO HSBA100T_TBL (CMPYCD, CUSTCD, INPRCGBN, OUTPRCGBN, HDAMT, RCVDD, AGRPCD, BGRPCD, CGRPCD, AREA, DAMDANG, TELNO, EMAIL, REMARK, USEYN, ADDTIME, UPDTIME, UPDEMP) VALUES (#{cmpycd}, #{custcd}, #{inprcgbn}, #{outprcgbn}, IFNULL(#{hdamt}, 0), IFNULL(#{rcvdd}, 0), #{agrpcd}, #{bgrpcd}, #{cgrpcd}, #{area}, #{cdamdang}, #{ctelno}, #{cemail}, #{remark}, #{useyn}, NOW(), NOW(), #{updemp}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE INPRCGBN = VALUES(INPRCGBN), OUTPRCGBN = VALUES(OUTPRCGBN), RCVDD = VALUES(RCVDD), AGRPCD = VALUES(AGRPCD), BGRPCD = VALUES(BGRPCD), CGRPCD = VALUES(CGRPCD), AREA = VALUES(AREA), DAMDANG = VALUES(DAMDANG), TELNO = VALUES(TELNO), EMAIL = VALUES(EMAIL), REMARK = VALUES(REMARK), USEYN = VALUES(USEYN), UPDTIME = NOW(), UPDEMP = VALUES(UPDEMP)

insert into haba020t_tbl (cmpycd, custcd, custno, custnm, custgbn, bossnm, juminno, legalno, custkind, custtype, telno, faxno, postno, address, d_address, iogbn, fndymd, stdymd, clsymd, singrd, status, gujoa, banknm, elcyn, useyn, addtime, updtime, updemp, gigbcd, outcustcd) values (#{cmpycd}, coalesce(nullif(#{custcd}, ''), concat(#{custcd}, lpad(ifnull(max(cast(x.custcd as unsigned)), 0) + 2, 7, '0'))), #{custno}, #{custnm}, #{custgbn}, #{bossnm}, #{juminno}, #{legalno}, #{custkind}, #{custtype}, #{telno}, #{faxno}, #{postno}, #{address}, #{d_address}, #{iogbn}, #{fndymd}, #{stdymd}, #{clsymd}, #{singrd}, #{status}, #{gujoa}, #{banknm}, #{elcyn}, #{useyn}, now(), now(), #{updemp}, #{gigbcd}, #{outcustcd})

insert into hsba100t_tbl (cmpycd, custcd, inprcgbn, outprcgbn, hdamt, rcvdd, agrpcd, bgrpcd, cgrpcd, area, damdang, telno, email, remark, useyn, addtime, updtime, updemp) VALUES (#{cmpycd}, #{custcd}, #{inprcgbn}, #{outprcgbn}, IFNULL(#{hdamt}, 0), IFNULL(#{rcvdd}, 0), #{agrpcd}, #{bgrpcd}, #{cgrpcd}, #{area}, #{cdamdang}, #{ctelno}, #{cemail}, #{remark}, #{useyn}, NOW(), NOW(), #{updemp})

INSERT INTO HSBA900T_TBL (CMPYCD, CDGBN, CODE, CDNM, REMARK, DSPORD, USEYN, ADDTIME, UPDTIME, UPDEMP) VALUES (#{cmpycd}, #{cdgbn}, #{code}, #{cdnm}, #{remark}, CAST(IFNULL(NULLIF(#{dspord}, ''), '0') AS SIGNED), #{useyn}, NOW(), NOW(), #{updemp}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE CDNM = VALUES(CDNM), REMARK = VALUES(REMARK), DSPORD = VALUES(DSPORD), USEYN = VALUES(USEYN), UPDTIME = NOW(), UPDEMP = VALUES(UPDEMP)
mapper.select:
select custcd, custnm from haba020t_tbl where cmpycd = #{cmpycd} and iogbn in ('010','030')
and custnm like concat('%', #{custnm}, '%')
and useyn = 'Y' order by custcd
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hsba130t_tbl (CMPYCD, CUSTCD, TRANCD, AREA, POSTNO, ADDRESS, D_ADDRESS, DAMDANG, TELNO, EMAIL, USEYN, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, ADDTIME, UPDTIME, UPDEMP) VALUES (#{cmpycd}, #{custcd}, IFNULL((SELECT LPAD(CAST(IFNULL(MAX(CAST(x.TRANCD AS UNSIGNED)), 0) + 1 AS CHAR), 2, '0') FROM hsba130t_tbl x WHERE x.CMPYCD = #{cmpycd} AND x.CUSTCD = #{custcd}), '01'), IFNULL(NULLIF(#{area}, ''), '000'), #{postno}, #{address}, #{d_address}, #{damdang}, #{telno}, #{email}, IFNULL(#{useyn}, 'Y'), #{latitude}, #{longitude}, NOW(), NOW(), #{updemp})
